free_tier.stated: Free Plan $0 / month, No Credit Card, Unmetered Security Traffic

egress.terms: The free plan carries 50 GB of traffic per month and the L4 Proxy row is 'Paid Value-Added'. The L4 proxy itself is 'only available with the Enterprise Edition package'.; ingress: tcp+udp

interface_detail: L4 proxy instances are created in the console with forwarding rules, up to 2,000 rules per instance
tooling: EdgeOne console or API; no client-side daemon
chaining: an origin on any VM by IP or domain name, so a free VM works as the origin; only the package price blocks it

limits.value: The L4 proxy is only available with the Enterprise Edition package
free plan 50 GB traffic per month, paid plans 500 GB and 3 TB

binding_note: At 1 TiB/month the byte count is irrelevant: the Enterprise Edition package is what stands between the client and an L4 rule. On the free plan the available volume for UDP is zero.

identity_cost.detail: An Enterprise Edition package or a prepaid plan for the L4 proxy; the free plan is 'No Credit Card' but carries no L4 proxy at all.

reliability_note: the L4 forwarding rules cannot pass the client IP over TOA or Proxy Protocol V1 on UDP; only Proxy Protocol V2 carries it for UDP
confidence_note: The Enterprise-only note, the TCP/UDP forwarding rule fields and the free-plan allowance are each quoted from pages read today. The Enterprise price is not published.

evidence.proved: Note: The L4 proxy is only available with the Enterprise Edition package.
Forwarding protocol of L4 proxy. Valid values: TCP and UDP; Single origin lets you enter the IP address or domain name of a single origin
Free Plan $0 / month, No Credit Card, Unmetered Security Traffic, traffic column 50 GB / 500 GB / 3 TB, and an L4 Proxy line marked Paid Value-Added

notes: The free plan's 'Unmetered Security Traffic' is attack-side language, not clean-traffic allowance: the same page's traffic row is 50 GB and the L4 row is paid. Three candidate readings of the L4 row were considered: (1) paid add-on available on any plan, (2) Enterprise only, (3) mis-extracted table. The L4 overview note settles it as (2).

extras.wg_detail: L4 proxy forwarding rules accept 'Valid values: TCP and UDP', so a WireGuard datagram is forwarded to the origin; the free plan cannot create one.
extras.volume_stated: The free plan carries 50 GB of traffic per month and the L4 Proxy row is 'Paid Value-Added'. The L4 proxy itself is 'only available with the Enterprise Edition package'.
extras.transit_note: EdgeOne's layer-4 proxy nodes carry the bytes to the origin
